dedupe_keys.name: elk global emission inventory energy for transport sector 2019

description: DLR’s EmissionsLandKarte energy-for-transport inventory estimates global emissions from oil-refinery combustion allocated to transport fuels in 2019. Monthly and annual gridded products combine national refinery reports, emission factors, IEA energy balances and fuel-trade information from COMTRADE and EUROSTAT. Refinery locations come from EPRTR and the Global Energy Observatory. The current public directory supplies NetCDF files for black carbon, carbon dioxide, carbon monoxide, non-methane volatile organic compounds, nitrogen oxides, particulate matter and sulphur dioxide. Downloads are free under CC-BY-4.0. The inventory can supply upstream refinery emissions to transport-energy and fuel-supply simulations, complementing direct vehicle-emission inventories. It is not a map of all refinery emissions or a measured operating history: the transport share is allocated from fuel and trade accounts. The registry’s older description mentions only black carbon, whereas the current provider page and file listing identify multiple pollutants. Grid spacing and units must be checked in product documentation before combining these fields with other inventories.
